newsitem.title: USA: Fields says optimistic on 2nd half 1997.
newsitem.headline: Fields says optimistic on 2nd half 1997.

text.p: Fields Aircraft Spares Inc Thursday additional said new air carrier and component makers now negotiating contracts with the company are giving it an optimistic outlook for the remainder of 1997.
"We expect excellent top-line growth, and profits in both the third and fourth quarters," Alan Fields, chief executive officer, said in a statement.
He said Fields' programs for relieving major air carriers with costs for holding and managing inventories, is paying off in dramatically improved bottom-line performance.
Earlier, Fileds reported a second quarter profit of $0.05 a share versus a loss of $0.06 a share one year ago.
Fields Aircraft Spares is a distributor of aircraft cabin interior replacement products and is a broker for a wide variety of factory new parts.
